plan.narration_reading: Opens on #07 (Christ's bowed head at the moment of death) under 'a psalm's last line and Jesus' last breath... it is done'. #09 (the wide day-is-done) on 'the psalm closes looking ahead to God's saving work'. #11 (the finished-work centre) on 'its final line: that he hath done this. Done.' #08 (the torn veil) on 'as Jesus hung dying, John records: It is finished'. #10 (the hands at rest) on 'different words a thousand years apart — the same note: a finished work'. #12 (nothing left to carry) on 'what's left for you to finish?'. #13 (the open door home) on 'Nothing — only Someone to come home to'. #14 (the One who said it is done) on the closing line. Hero #04 (It Is Finished, the cross) closes.
plan.red_team_notes: 8 body clips over 20 beats; the 'finished work' motif recurs (#11/#08/#10) but each marks a distinct beat (psalm's done / John's 'it is finished' / the two a thousand years apart). Hero #04 and #07/#10 are all passion frames; #04 is the only cross-on-beam close so the bookend still reads as a return.
